messages.author: 6bd6007bd798b03d
messages.subject: full stops in variable names
parts:
Hi all,

I am having trouble with the following modified example:

mtcars %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cyl.new = factor(cyl)) %>%
  ggvis(~wt, ~mpg, stroke = ~cyl.new) %>%
  layer_lines()

which produces a white plot in the RStudio viewer. Replacing cyl.new with cylNew allows the code to work fine and produces the correct plot. Any ideas? My dplyr is version 0.2 and ggvis is version 0.3.0.1.

Thanks in advance,

Phillip

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: full stops in variable names

I think we might be using .'s for a special purpose at the moment -
I'd recommend staying away from them.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: full stops in variable names
parts:
Hi Philip - I just pushed a fix for this in the development version. It also requires the development version of jsonlite. You can install them with:
  library(devtools)
  install_github('jeroenooms/jsonlite')
  install_github('rstudio/ggvis')

If you run into any more problems with this, please let us know.

-Winston
